name: Củ Chi

queries.query: Cu Chi Vietnam official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS API Ho Chi Minh
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the HCMC DONRE Geoportal catalog and its Củ Chi land-use-status dataset, plus the national land-inventory map operated by the Department of Land Administration. The accessible official material did not expose an anonymous cadastral parcel feature endpoint.

queries.query: Củ Chi bản đồ địa chính thửa đất Văn phòng đăng ký đất đai GIS chính thức
queries.result: Vietnamese first-party discovery identified the HCMC DONRE Geoportal record for “Dữ liệu Hiện trạng sử dụng đất năm 2019 Huyện Củ Chi – Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh” and official government guidance naming the local land-registration office/branch as a cadastral-record custodian. The catalog record concerns land-use status, not a safely downloadable parcel layer, and no anonymous parcel geometry response was qualified.

registryEvidence.custodian: Ho Chi Minh City Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) Geoportal; local land-registration office/branch under Viet Nam land administration
registryEvidence.locality: Củ Chi District, Ho Chi Minh City
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The HCMC first-party catalog specifically lists a Củ Chi land-use-status dataset and describes OGC web delivery for cataloged land-status maps. This evidences a local government geospatial custodian, not open citywide cadastral parcel geometry or a qualified parcel API.

parcelDiscovery.source: HCMC DONRE Geoportal / national land-inventory map
parcelDiscovery.note: The Củ Chi catalog record is land-use-status data rather than a parcel feature response. No native parcel identity, parcel schema, CRS, or ID-plus-geometry response was retained. The exact WUP point was not shifted and was not used as an absence test.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Direct curl request exceeded 20 seconds without a response; indexed first-party search evidence was available through discovery, but no live viewer configuration, service URL, schema, CRS, or parcel response was obtained. This is not evidence of citywide absence.
Public national land-inventory application shell loaded and referenced JavaScript configuration. It is an inventory/statistics application, not evidence of an anonymous cadastral parcel layer.
Returned public region metadata {ki_kiem_ke: 2025, params: {year: 2025, global: vn}}; no parcel IDs or geometry.
Returned the application not-found HTML page; no public configuration or parcel service was exposed.
Returned Vietnamese login-required response; no login, credential, or private token was attempted.
Returned Vietnamese login-required response; no search or parcel request was made through the authenticated route.
